reason: The README documents a DeepSeek Harness plugin for pinning assistant, tool, and text evidence and recalling it into later model turns through Web UI controls and commands.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中固定助手回复、工具结果或文本，并将固定内容召回到模型上下文中。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for pinning assistant replies, tool results, or text and recalling them into the model context.

capabilities: Pins assistant replies, tool results, or free-form text in a session
Recalls pinned content into the model turn
Persists pin and removal events for session continuity
Adds Web UI controls and slash commands for pin management
